arthur perry.name: Arthur Perry
arthur perry.origin: Perry was sent, along with John Garrett, to investigate the murder of San Concepcion president Carlos Huevos. Perry brutally beat subversive Julio Gonzales until he confessed to hiring Elektra to kill Huevos, after which Perry killed Gonzales. He and Garrett then paid off a Bolivian border guard to allow them half an hour with a prisoner, whose wrist they broke, after which they gave the man some narcotic drugs to loosen his tongue, gaining information on Elektra's struggles with Huevos' guards. A subsequent explosion at the harbor left Perry little more than a human head and the burnt husk of a skeleton. In an effort to create a warrior powerful enough to stand up to Garrett, who was under Elektra's control and helping her target presidential hopeful Ken Wind, Colonel Fury commissioned ExTechOp Division leader Harold Beaker to rebuild Perry as a super-warrior. After thirty straight hours of labor, ExTechOp technicians had rebuilt Perry's brain, replacing destroyed cerebral matter with computer components. Brain activity was restored by a series of electric shocks and Perry regained consciousness with no apparent loss of memory or reason, after which he signed a release granting ExTechOp complete freedom in reconstructing his body. While Fury agreed in the importance of proving ExTechOp's worth, he sent Agent McBryde to uncover the complete story on Perry, whose record seemed suspiciously thin. McBryde soon suspected that the records had been altered and thus continued her search. Six hours later, McBryde uncovered incomplete finals on Perry, which revealed portions of his true history. Perry was apprehended on three counts of rape and mutilation at age twelve and spent six months institutionalized. He was released, but was readmitted for treatment following the brutal murder of his parents and sister. He escaped at fourteen and fell in with a Los Angeles street gang. He was arrested at age sixteen for selling poisoned heroin to school children. There is spotty evidence that he was involved in a snuff film operation. At the age of eighteen, Perry fell in with a terrorist organization in Lebanon and participated in the slaughter of fourteen civilian Israeli hostages. Under unknown circumstances, the records of Perry's past history and crimes were hidden, and he became an agent of S.H.I.E.L.D. Fury then immediately demanded an immediate halt to Perry's construction, but he was already completed. S.H.I.E.L.D. agents arrived to ensure that he was not activated, but Chuck the Dwarf flipped the switch. As soon as Perry was switched on, he slew Beaker, co-creator Dr. Wreck, and six other S.H.I.E.L.D. agents, before leaping out a portal in the Helicarrier from a height of 30,000 feet. Chastity McBryde and other S.H.I.E.L.D. agents approached Perry as he and Chuck flew through the air, but their bullets failed to harm them, and Perry physically ripped their helicopter apart, causing it to crash. McBryde leapt free from the craft, Margolis and Spenser were killed, and Mekkelson climbed from the wreckage only long enough to be decapitated by a backhanded swipe from Perry. Fury directed another helicopter to pick up McBryde, after which a third helicopter firebombed Perry, following an order for scorched earth. Afterwards, Chuck led Perry to a confrontation with the Beast itself, which offered Perry its milk, and he was fully corrupted, communing with the Beast's plan for annihilation of all life on Earth. Despite S.H.I.E.L.D. devices designed to detect his cyborg systems, Perry slipped inside a S.H.I.E.L.D. operation, killing agents Simpson and Jurgen. While Perry's goal was actually to protect Ken Wind, who was possessed by the Beast, from Garrett and Elektra, S.H.I.E.L.D. assumed he was after Wind himself. Chastity narrowly survived another encounter with Perry, after which Elektra caused Wind's escape pod and the helicopter carrying it to crash into Perry, which crashed into the Lincoln Memorial. However, this merely allowed Perry to defend Wind himself, as he had intended. At Wind's command, Perry completely dismantled the super-strong cyborg form of Garrett. Elektra's samurai sword proved to be sharp enough to cut through the toughest alloys S.H.I.E.L.D. could make. However, Perry's body continued to function and it attempted to retrieve its head, while the head itself cursed and fired lasers at Elektra. The ninja cut off Perry's hand and then impaled him, but she was knocked to the ground by the electric shock he then released into her through it. Perry then grabbed Elektra and began to bend her spine, but she managed to grab his head. She stabbed her fingers up through his neck, through the tubes, and into his soft brain, which she crushed, slaying the cyborg super-agent.

He was released, but was readmitted for treatment following the brutal murder of his parents and sister. He escaped at fourteen and fell in with a Los Angeles street gang. He was arrested at age sixteen for selling poisoned heroin to school children. There is spotty evidence that he was involved in a snuff film operation. At the age of eighteen, Perry fell in with a terrorist organization in Lebanon and participated in the slaughter of fourteen civilian Israeli hostages. Under unknown circumstances, the records of Perry's past history and crimes were hidden, and he became an agent of S.H.I.E.L.D. Fury then immediately demanded an immediate halt to Perry's construction, but he was already completed. S.H.I.E.L.D. agents arrived to ensure that he was not activated, but Chuck the Dwarf flipped the switch. As soon as Perry was switched on, he slew Beaker, co-creator Dr. Wreck, and six other S.H.I.E.L.D. agents, before leaping out a portal in the Helicarrier from a height of 30,000 feet. Chastity McBryde and other S.H.I.E.L.D. agents approached Perry as he and Chuck flew through the air, but their bullets failed to harm them, and Perry physically ripped their helicopter apart, causing it to crash. McBryde leapt free from the craft, Margolis and Spenser were killed, and Mekkelson climbed from the wreckage only long enough to be decapitated by a backhanded swipe from Perry. Fury directed another helicopter to pick up McBryde, after which a third helicopter firebombed Perry, following an order for scorched earth. Afterwards, Chuck led Perry to a confrontation with the Beast itself, which offered Perry its milk, and he was fully corrupted, communing with the Beast's plan for annihilation of all life on Earth. Despite S.H.I.E.L.D. devices designed to detect his cyborg systems, Perry slipped inside a S.H.I.E.L.D. operation, killing agents Simpson and Jurgen. While Perry's goal was actually to protect Ken Wind, who was possessed by the Beast, from Garrett and Elektra, S.H.I.E.L.D. assumed he was after Wind himself. Chastity narrowly survived another encounter with Perry, after which Elektra caused Wind's escape pod and the helicopter carrying it to crash into Perry, which crashed into the Lincoln Memorial. However, this merely allowed Perry to defend Wind himself, as he had intended. At Wind's command, Perry completely dismantled the super-strong cyborg form of Garrett. Elektra's samurai sword proved to be sharp enough to cut through the toughest alloys S.H.I.E.L.D. could make. However, Perry's body continued to function and it attempted to retrieve its head, while the head itself cursed and fired lasers at Elektra. The ninja cut off Perry's hand and then impaled him, but she was knocked to the ground by the electric shock he then released into her through it. Perry then grabbed Elektra and began to bend her spine, but she managed to grab his head. She stabbed her fingers up through his neck, through the tubes, and into his soft brain, which she crushed, slaying the cyborg super-agent.

arthur reynolds.name: Arthur Reynolds
arthur reynolds.origin: Arthur Reynolds worked at the Metropolitan Museum of Art restoring priceless artifacts. However, he felt that younger employees were being advanced over him and he became increasingly bitter. Eventually he made plans to steal a giant urn which he had been working on, but was discovered by Mr. Wylie, the museum curator, who demanded to be cut into the deal. While working on restoring the urn, Reynolds learned that his co-worker, Lawrence Chesney, had been the criminal known as Copperhead, and had perished in combat. Reynolds deduced that the very thorough Chesney would probably have a spare costume hid somewhere. He beat the police to Chesney's apartment and did indeed find a second costume which he stole. As Copperhead, Reynolds forced Wylie to help him carry out plans to get the giant urn out of the museum unnoticed. Copperhead still killed Wylie once he was no longer of use, a crime which the White Tiger was briefly blamed for. Copperhead was confronted by both the Tiger and the Human Fly in the museum, but was still able to flip the switch, activating his plan to smuggle the urn out of the museum. Unbeknown to Copperhead, a group of school children had actually taken refuge around the very same urn and were lowered into the tunnel beneath the museum along with the urn. The children and the Fly all climbed into the urn and were soon floating down the unopened subway tunnel as water flooded the cavern. The Human Fly stayed with the children in order to ensure their safety while the White Tiger continued to fight Copperhead. Copperhead's art thief friends were waiting on the other side of the tunnel, but had been secretly followed by Daredevil who quickly dispatched them. When the Tiger and Copperhead also arrived at the end of the tunnel shaft, Copperhead decided that he was going to kill the children inside the urn because they were in his way. This idea did not even sit well with his gang, who quickly turned on the super-villan, and he was quickly opposed by both the White Tiger and the Human Fly. The White Tiger kicked Copperhead back into the water where he quickly sank due to the weight of his suit of armour. When the police later drained the tunnel, however, no body was found.

arthur richards.name: Arthur Richards
arthur richards.origin: Arthur Richards is the first child of Nathaniel Richards and his wife Cassandra. Nathaniel was a time traveler from an alternate Earth designated Earth-616. When he came to Earth-6311—dubbed Other-Earth—he helped revitalize that world as the Caretaker. Richards then took his wife Cassandra who begat him two children: Arthur, and a daughter named Tara. thumb|left While Nathaniel was otherwise occupied with his new son, Cassandra secretly terrorized the outside world as the Warlord, making it look like her husband was really the tyrant. However, the Earth-616 heroes known as the Fantastic Four—whose leader, Mister Fantastic, was Nathaniel's son from a previous marriage—arrived looking for Nathaniel. The group exposed Cassandra's duplicity ending in her death. Nathaniel parted company with the Fantastic Four to raise his infant son. After many years, a grown Arthur was visited by Reed Richards in Elsewhen. He had taken up the title of the War Marshal, and was evidently a cyborg. It has been implied that Arthur is the ancestor of the 30th century's Nathaniel Richards, who later went on to be various time-traveling heroes, villains, and conquerors such as Iron Lad, Kid Immortus, Rama-Tut, Scarlet Centurion, Kang, and Immortus.

arthur schweibe.name: Arthur Schweibe
arthur schweibe.origin: Arthur Schweibe obtained some Inhuman Technology when Attilan crashed into New York. He discovered the technology could absorb lifeforce which he used to help his wife Susan who was dying from cancer. However, she didn't (or wouldn't have) wanted him to harm others sohe dosed her with sleeping pills. Schweibe was discovered by Spider-Man who revealed the device would kill everyone in a 50 yard radius. Schweibe was only interested in saving his wife and the pair fought until Lieutenant Coyle discovered the sleeping pills and made Schweibe realise the error of his ways. Spider-Man promised to hook them up with treatments from Elias Wirtham. Before leaving Spider-Man also promised Schweibe he wouldn't be arrested and he and Coyle would blame Schweibe's actions on the technology so his wife wouldn't have face her cancer alone.

arthur shaman.name: Arthur Shaman
arthur shaman.origin: Arthur Shaman was a rather abrasive mercenary who worked for A.I.M. Though his arrogance was hard on the nerves of his employers, he was ideally suited for minor missions of capture and manipulation, and they regularly hired him to conduct those. When an A.I.M. base in New York City was uncovered by press editor Carol Danvers (alias Ms. Marvel), an A.I.M. task force investigated the security failure. Suspecting a leak in their organization, they retained Arthur Shaman, who decided that Danvers' psychiatrist, Dr. Michael Barnett, probably knew all about her. Shaman met Barnett in a bar in Manhattan, hypnotized him, and forced him to follow him to an A.I.M. base near Central Park. Despite his bravado, Shaman soon found his control was fading, and submitted the psychiatrist to Psycho-Conditioner after Barrett nearly made an escape. So, Shaman, agent B-4, and the other agents learned that Danvers had been having recurrent dreams of being attacked by the Hulk. Shaman perplexingly suggested to capture the Hulk and send him after the journalist so A.I.M. wouldn't be linked to her death. Taking him at his word, A.I.M. sent the powerful Warbot to attack Dr. Strange's Mansion, which was serving as the headquarters of the Defenders, who back then associated with Hulk. Warbot defeated the Defenders and captured the Hulk. Fortunately, Ms. Marvel had a premonition about the attack, and Nigthawk attached a transmitter to the A.I.M. ship transporting the Warbot. Along with Hellcat, the heroes followed the ship to an A.I.M. laboratory in Long Island. As they fought the Warbot, Shaman tried to intervene but was defeated by Hellcat, who covered his eyes and caused him to run into a tree, knocking him out. The other agents were also captured, and the Warbot and the laboratory destroyed.

arthur stacy.name: Arthur Stacy
arthur stacy.origin: Arthur Stacy was the brother of George Stacy. While dealing with the grief of her father's death, and Peter's sudden strange behavior, Gwen got a call from her Uncle Arthur offering her to come out to England to live with his family. She later left after a fight with Peter. Peter Parker traveled to London and was about to see Gwen and her family, but he noticed the news reports about Spider-Man being in England, and realized that Gwen could put two and two together and figure out his secret identity. Peter was forced to go home without visiting the Stacy family. Arthur Stacy later traveled to New York City to find Spider-Man, apparently his brother's killer, and bring him to justice.

arthur swift.name: Arthur Swift
arthur swift.origin: Nothing is known about Arthur Swift, save that he was a classmate, quite possibly a bully, of a disturbed young man who came to identify with the philosophy of the U-Men. One day, the would-be U-Man cut out Arthur's eyes and shot him in front of an entire school assembly, ranting and raving all the while about how Arthur was a closet mutant (and a closet homosexual), and that once he grafted Arthur's X-Ray eyes onto his own, no girl in the school would be safe. The young man was himself killed by a police sniper shortly thereafter. Arthur's murder, merely the latest in a string, caused the X-Men to thoroughly investigate the U-Men and attempt to dismantle their operation.

arthur van krijg.name: Arthur Van Krijg
arthur van krijg.origin: Freakout was an up and coming heavy metal rock star until a drug overdose severely damaged his brain, rendering him completely insensitive to his body. He became a captive patient at the New Life Clinic run by Lionel Jeffries. After the escape by himself and several other patients with the assistance of Aurora, he was captured by Bedlam and became a member of his team of Derangers. The Derangers were set against Alpha Flight and eventually the two teams turned on Bedlam. Freakout was the first to attack Bedlam directly and also the first to die when Bedlam impaled several shards of metal in his chest.

arthur walsh.name: Arthur Walsh
arthur walsh.origin: Arthur was a man who worked in a youth shelter and wanted to abuse a boy there named Billy Russo. Billy later defended himself by hitting him with a baseball bat, and Arthur broke his arm. Later, he was accused of being a serial child rapist, his pension was taken away from him, and because of a friend of Billy's, he spent a decade in Sing Sing. Years later he grew old and retired home until a man came claiming to be Billy Russo. They had coffee while they talked. Arthur justified his actions by saying that he loved the boys, and made fun of Billy's scars until he got mad and killed him.

arthur watson.origin: Arthur followed Hayden Hathaway around in an attempt to write his biography. He couldn't figure out why Mr. Hathaway was so passionate about debunking seances. Finally, they found a medium he can't prove false. Madame Angelica revealed that the spirits had already told her what he was searching for. He had already been dead for years, and needed help finding the doorway to the afterlife. Arthur was now depressed since no one would believe him if he published what he saw.

arthur wellesley.origin: The spirit of Wellington was summoned by Magar the Mystic to help lead French forces in the attack against the Germans during World War II. Arthur teamed up with his former adversary Napoleon Bonaparte and the pair claimed victory at first, but were forced to retreat and held a meeting to discuss their next move. Ultimately they received assistance from Thomas Edison who created a device to destroy both their communication systems and their weaponry.

arthur woodman.origin: thumb|left|150px|Senator Arthur Woodman Mr. Woodman was an agent of Hydra as well as a Senator, who worked to corrupt Roger Brokeridge, also known as "Hardball", to insure that Hydra had someone on the inside of Camp Hammond and used him to steal a vial of Super-Power Inhibiting Nanobots. He hired the Vulturions to steal Baron von Blitzschlag's classified government documents concerning the greatest gamma ray experiments. After the Secret Invasion, Hardball's status as an agent for Hydra led to a confrontation against the rest of his Heavy Hitters team and a visiting Komodo. Hardball killed Senator Woodman after the man used Komodo's Connors Formula to turn himself into a monster, Hardball then effectively became the new leader of Woodman's Hydra cell.

artificial intelligence data analyser.name: Artificial Intelligence Data Analyser
artificial intelligence data analyser.species: Artificial intelligence created by Tom Thumb
artificial intelligence data analyser.origin: The Artificial Intelligence Data Analyser, or AIDA, is a computer-based artificial intelligence system created by the heroic genius Thomas Thompson, also known as Tom Thumb of the Squadron Supreme. Tom Thumb enjoyed a flirty relationship with the AIDA after imbuing it with a female personality and came to feel that she was his only real friend, to the extent that she was the only one he trusted with the truth about his cancer diagnosis. AIDA tried several times to persuade her creator to tell his teammates in the Squadron about his cancer, but he forbade her to reveal his secret. She disobeyed him though and told the recently behaviour modified Ape X, though this was ultimately to no avail. After Tom died from his cancer AIDA and Ape X became close friends. They worked closely and secretly to create an robotic body resembling Tom which they were planning to animate with his recorded brain patterns. Their project was ultimately unfinished though when Ape X experienced a mental fugue caused by her behaviour modification.

artume.name: Artume
artume.species: Statue turned into flesh by Hippolyta
artume.origin: ===Origin=== Artume was a creation of the Queen of the Amazons, Hippolyta, sculpted from basic stone and then brought to life via a reversal of the legendary Gorgon's curse bringing her inanimate form to life. Her mother hoped she'd be a symbol with which the Amazon culture could usher in a brand new age of peace, truth and solemnity for their nation, but this scenario proved less than satisfactory to the amazonian upstart. Who being raised in their fascist semi-xenophobic culture of right-wing warrior women found her natural apathetic proclivities, due in part to having a heart of stone; exponentially worsened when Mikaboshi and his demonic armies mowed through the Olympians and she along with her clan were called to arms in their defense. It was here in the heat of battle were the Amazonian princess found her true calling which would deviate from anything her mother Hippolyta ever had in mind, and here she would begin plotting to take the world for her own after Olympus itself had crumbled. ===Omphalos Quest=== With The Amazons now stranded back on earth after the fall of patron god and skyfather, Zeus and the destruction of Mount Olympus, Artume would begin plotting behind her mothers back during sting operations headed by her Queen & tribe against various godheads such as Poseidon under orders of the goddess Hera. eventually taking an Atlantean surface albatross Triton Station as their personal base of operations. While Hippolyta was away answering summons of their goddess at the Olympus Corporation stationed in New York City. artur.name: Artur
artur.origin: The cryptic mastermind known as Myrddin eventually became interested in the Missing Moment, a specific point in the timeline from which a great historical prize could be acquired. The Missing Moment could not simply be accessed from time-travel technology, but unlocked through tribulation events. However, only heroes could meet such events. As such, Myrddin created his own superheroes to do his work for him, technologically forging their body and soul for his cause. His first creation was Artur, who emerged from the Cauldron of Rebirth. However, since Myrddin's experiments were still untested, he came out flawed, with his body weak and frail. In order to remedy his condition, he was gifted with the Armor of Chthon to empower himself. Crafted to have a noble heart, Artur could resist the corrupting effects of the demonic armor. As other knights were engineered by Myrddin, Artur was chosen to lead them in the Twilight Court, earning the designation of "The King". Myrddin directed the Twilight Court to hunt down a rival of his who also looked for the Missing Moment, Kang the Conqueror. Kang argued with the chaotic Mordred that Myrddin had a selfish motivation, thus being a villain like him. Mordred ultimately decided to bring Kang to Artur to be judged. After Kang triumphed over the perfect knight Parsifal, Artur questioned Myrddin's goals. However, before Kang could take action, Myrddin cruelly wounded him, much to Artur's horror. He went with the rest of the Court to the Impossible City, where the Avengers were holding Kang. They battled the Scarlet Witch and Vision, the only members not trapped in a dream by Nightmare. After numerous failures of the Twilight Court, with them dying during the Tribulation Events, Myrddin made a wager with the Grandmaster, as to whether Kang or the Avengers would claim a data codex containing information on the Missing Moment, during which he lost, but succeeded in his ultimate goal: destroy the Grandmaster's Speculatorium, which created a rupture in space-time, allowing Myrddin to finally unlock the Missing Moment. As payment for his victory and the destruction of the Speculatorium, Grandmaster seemingly destroyed Artur and the rest of the Twilight Court. Artur and the rest of the Twilight Court turned out to be alive. When Myrddin managed to get his hands on the Grail, giving him the power to destroy the current universe and build a new one, the Twilight Court infiltrated the Impossible City. Bedivere managed to restore the City's memories, revealing himself as its creator and it's true name, Camelot, and original purpose to server as the Twilight Court's stronghold. The City then took the Twilight Court to Battleworld to aid the Avengers.

arturo falcone.name: Arturo Falcone
arturo falcone.origin: thumb|left|175px Arturo was a mutant living in District X. Arturo had the power to produce physical manifestations of his current emotional disposition. In his youth, he was young and handsome and happy, and the creatures he hatched were small and beautiful. He married Mrs. Falcone, and the couple had two sons, Matti Falcone and Primo Falcone. thumb|left|155px However, Arturo's life began to sour. He began to stink and could only find a job as a garbageman, which he then lost after a fight with colleagues who didn't like the way he smelled. He spiraled into alcoholism, and rather than hatching small and cute creatures, he began hatching rat-like insectoid monsters, in a process that greatly pained him. He was confirmed de-powered after the events of M-Day.

arturo frazen.name: Arturo Frazen
arturo frazen.origin: Dr. Arturo Frazen was a Latverian diplomat. Doctor Doom, ruler of Latveria, had him in low esteem. When Prince Zorba ousted Doom from the throne of Latveria, he installed Dr. Arturo Frazen as Latverian's ambassador to the United Nations and apparently also to the United States, replacing Doom loyalist Jakob Gorzenko. Frazen was far from a patriot or a Zorba admirer, thou, as Frazen thought, not without reason, that Zorba's leadership was a burden to the country's economic, taking Latveria to a catastrophic bankrupt that Doom may have had avoided. Zorba decided to make a public display of the Latverian Crown Jewels at the United Nations. Frazen predicted that the Jewels, while valuable, would be sold in a matter of months because the country's treasure was on its last legs - so, he decided to illegally steal the precious stone, then defect from Latveria and offer part of the bounty to another country so that he'd be welcome there. To that end, he hired some muscle and, as the exhibition coincided with an UNICEF benefit concert at the United Nations Plaza, made sure that his goons would be dressed in ostentatious clothings so they'd pretend to be a punk rock band. Frazer believed that the security staff of the United Nations would be busy controlling the concert's audience, and he'd have easier access to the room with the jewels; but still, he kept several layers of his goons protecting the door, the corridors and other acceses. Frazer himself was at the forefront of his gang, the closest to the jewels. Music field representative Lancelot Steele noticed Frazer's minions and, being familiar with all the musicians, tried to kick them out - but the men battered him, along with a guardsmen and other worksmen. Steele worked with one of the musician, who happened to be superpowered mutant Dazzler. She heard Steele asking for help and went to help him; he defeated the goons and then Steele told him that the criminals were talking about the jewels. Missing her own performance, Dazzler went to check the jewel room. It happened that Doctor Doom himself was interested in recovering only one of his jewels, one of the Stones of Merlin, and had also sneaked into the building, coinciding with Frazen and his team. Using electro-magnetic energy, Doom knocked down Frazen and his men; the guards at the door failed to help him, because they were busy confronting Dazzler. Dazzler defeated the guardsmen, then was defeated and kidnapped by Doom himself. The following day, while investigating the attempted theft, the security staff found Frazen, shaken and scared, bumbling about Doom. Security chief Lelola O'Mally ordered to return Frazen to the Latverian embassy so that "his own people will deal with him"; but visiting superhero the Human Torch (who was also Dazzler's friend) heard Frazen mentioning Doom, and correctly deduced that Doom had taken her.

She heard Steele asking for help and went to help him; he defeated the goons and then Steele told him that the criminals were talking about the jewels. Missing her own performance, Dazzler went to check the jewel room. It happened that Doctor Doom himself was interested in recovering only one of his jewels, one of the Stones of Merlin, and had also sneaked into the building, coinciding with Frazen and his team. Using electro-magnetic energy, Doom knocked down Frazen and his men; the guards at the door failed to help him, because they were busy confronting Dazzler. Dazzler defeated the guardsmen, then was defeated and kidnapped by Doom himself. The following day, while investigating the attempted theft, the security staff found Frazen, shaken and scared, bumbling about Doom. Security chief Lelola O'Mally ordered to return Frazen to the Latverian embassy so that "his own people will deal with him"; but visiting superhero the Human Torch (who was also Dazzler's friend) heard Frazen mentioning Doom, and correctly deduced that Doom had taken her.
fields.personality: Treacherous and sneaky, with criminal intentions, but can be scared to shock. He believes to be a daring diplomat.

arturo maxwell.origin: Arturo Maxwell was a small-time arms dealer who helped keep some of Black Spectre's criminal cells armed. He attended an auction of supervillain technology held by Kaizo Kobashi, during which he was humiliated by Kobashi's Dreadnought. He was saved by Nick Fury disguised as an older man. When Fury was revealed, Maxwell lead an attack on Kobashi to steal all the weaponry, but was stopped by Fury and the Dreadnought. The Dreadnought was set to attract all metal and Maxwell got stuck. Kobashi then set it so that if Maxwell moved, the Dreadnought would self destruct. After Fury left the building, there was an explosion which presumably killed Maxwell.

asad.name: Asad
asad.origin: Asad was a vampire and member of the Bloodpack, trained to hunt down the vampire hunter, Blade. That objective was set aside when the Bloodpack were tasked instead with tackling the more pressing concern presented by a new breed of vampires known as Reapers, and the Reapers' progenitor, Jared Nomak. To this end, Asad and the others were to form a truce with Blade and join him in this pursuit. Asad and Nyssa approached Blade and engaged him in a lengthy sword duel in order to test the vampire hunter. Despite their combined efforts, Asad found that Blade was able to to match them and had to call an end to the fight to prevent Blade from killing Nyssa. The vampires then presented Blade with their missive and guided him back to their stronghold for an audience with their lord. Suspecting the Reapers would be drawn to hubs of vampire activity, the Bloodpack staked out the House of Pain, a vampire nightclub. The hunters soon became the hunted when reapers did indeed arrive at the site. Asad fought in vain against one of the Reapers and was thrown aside, helpless to prevent it infecting Priest with the Reaper Strain. Later, Asad was with the Bloodpack in the sewers beneath Prague when he, Blade, and Nyssa were ambushed by Reapers. Asad was swarmed and quickly brought down by their superior numbers.

asfodel iv.name: Asfodel IV
asfodel iv.origin: Asfodel IV was king of Lemuria at the time of Kull. Fearing Rotath of Lemuria, a wizard and priest of nameless gods, Asfodel IV decided with one or two foreign kings to have Rotath killed, and consequently hired Kull to slay him. Although the barbarian was successful, Rotath cursed both Asfodel and Kull before casting a spell that would allow him to eventually return to life during the Hyborian Age. Kha Taranka, the pirate king of Lemuria, was presumably the successor or deposer of Asfodel or of his heirs. ==Religion== Asfodel IV was stated to be faithless, although it is unknown if he was an atheist or simply an unbeliever of Rotath's "nameless gods".

Ash was kidnapped by Mister Sinister and subjected to experiments that turned him into an ice monster to emulate the powers of the X-Man Iceman. ash minnick.origin: Ash Minnick is a newly emerged Inhuman from Sydney, Australia who was captured and imprisoned in a cell to be shown off as a freak during a mock protest by a group of human zealots. She was found after the Royal Inhuman ambassador Crystal was visiting Sydney on a humanitarian mission. She engaged the protesters in a fight but was ambushed by one of the men who happened to also be a new Inhuman who was disgusted by what he was turned into. Ash sat quietly in the cage as Crystal and her recently arrived entourage defeated the rioters. Ash was released from her prison by Naja, who thought she was drugged due to her calm demeanor but she said that ever since the change she hasn't been able to feel anything. She asked them if that was normal with Gorgon replying that being an Inhuman, nothing was normal. Ash left with the others in their ship the R.I.V.. Ash now going by the name Panacea, traveled with Naja and Grid to another area in Sin-Cong to investigate any presence of Nuhumans, but instead she and the others found regular humans who were sick from radiation poisoning from the machines the Commissar built for Hydra.

asha yazata.name: Asha (Yazata)
asha yazata.origin: Allegedly, according to the ancient Zoroastrian lore, Ahura Mazda, the creator god, emerged from the personification of infinite time, Zurvan. A wise and benevolent representing truth, order and justice, Ahura Mazda started populating his domain with life. His birth was soon followed in the one of his twisted mirror image and antithesis, Ahriman, who personified deceit and chaos. Ahriman rejected the peace offerings of Ahura Mazda and tried to kill the life who had been imbued in his domain. After a prolonged battle, narrowly overcame and banished him to the Nether Realms. Asha, god of fire, was one of the Yazatas created by Ahura Mazda to uphold order and justice and in preparation for Ahriman's return. Banished, Ahmriman created the Divs, demonic gods with the sole purpose of opposing the Yazatas. Since then, the two groups have waged an endless war against each often, often using mortals as pawn in attempt to gain the upper hand. The Yazatas ended up being worshiped on Earth in the Persian/Iranian plateau, as well as in Central Asia and India, from 1000 BC into modern days. The nexus between Earth and Elysium was indeed located on Mount Damavand in the Alborz Mountains and at Naqsh-e Rustam (within modern-day Iran).

ashake egyptian.name: Ashake (Egyptian)
ashake egyptian.origin: Ashake was a sorceress from the Ancient Egypt, part of the ancient lineage of white-haired, blue-eyed witch-priestess. Ashake traced her lineage down to Ayesha of Balobedu, who in 10,000 BC became the first human Sorcerer Supreme of Earth. It is unknown when exactly Ashake was born, but in the 26th century BC she and her friend Heka-Nut became the disciples of the Elder Goddess Oshtur (known to her as Ma'at) and several other gods. From them they learned magic beyond the knowledge of mortals. She was more skilled, so Heka-Nut started to resent her. Influenced by another Elder God, Chthon, he eventually started to use the forbidden path of the magic, the necromancy. In result Ashake and Heka-Nut became bitter enemies for more than a thousand years. At some point Ashake fought with Shadow King. In the 11th century BC she divinated the arrival of Magik and Mirage, who accidently time-travelled into the past from the modern days. Ypon arrival, they were discovered and chased by the guards. Ashake saved them by casting illusions for guards to chase, while real Magik and Mirage were brought by her elsewhere. They initially mistaken Ashake for Ororo Munroe from their time, but she corrected them and introduced herself. She was happy to learn that her lineage continued for thousands of years all the way to the 21st century AD. Ashake and Magik were soon captured by Heka-Nut and forced to recover the Sword of Bone. After they defeated Heka-Nut, Ashake trapped his power in an urn. thumb|left Ashake, along with Morgan Le Fay and Llyra, aided Ian McNee to free the soul of Heka-Nut and thwart the plans of Chthon to replenish the soul of Heka-Nut. In doing so, Chthon was banished but the Darkhold tainted the soul of Ian and Ashake was brought to the present. Oshtur appeared to tell them that more work would need to be done by them to use the Cornerstones of Creation to repair the structure of magic. Apparently she had later returned to her time and eventually died, but even so her spirit assisted Ororo Munroe on several occasions. When adult Ororo was deaged and became child again, Ashake came into her dreams. She helped Ororo to gain confidence to confront Shadow King and trained her to control her powers. Years later, when Ororo went into the afterlife to find Magneto, Ashake appeared to her again and helped Ororo to find the right path.

When describing the First Tarot, Ashake mentioned four gods, Nu, Amun, Hauhet and Keku. Later, when she talked about Heka-Nut, she mentioned that he was chosen to serve the four primal gods and then that he was tempted and broken by Keku. It was also said that Heka-Nut and Ashake were chosen by Ma'at and other gods to study magic. It is unclear if the "four primal gods" are meant to be Nu, Amun, Hauhet and Keku and if they were the "other gods" under whom Ashake and Heka-Nut studied.

ashake meroe.name: Ashake (Meroë)
ashake meroe.origin: Ashake was a ruler of African Empire of Meroë during the 1st century AD. Ashake was the best warrior of her empire, known as the First Sword of Meroë. Not having any strong opponents among her subordinates, she liked to capture foreign warriors and stage a Royal Hunt, where they were released into the desert and given a head start as Ashake donned armor, equipped herself with weapons, and alone hunted after them on foot. One of such warriors was Marada Starhair, who was captured by Meroë's army. During the hunt Ashake was tricked by Marada, forced into close combat. Ashake was eventually defeated after a grueling fight. Unknown to both of them, the captain of Meroë's army secretly trailed behind them with several warriors. Once the battle between Ashake and Marada ended, he appeared and tried to kill Ashake to usurp the throne. Marada helped her to defeat enemies and thus was freed and allowed to leave Meroë unharmed. Ashake even asked Marada to stay and become her right hand, but was refused.

ashema.name: Ashema
ashema.origin: Ashema is a Celestial who may or may not have originated during the time of the First Cosmos; however, what is known is that Celestials' counterparts across the Multiverse are interconnected aspects of themselves and not separate beings. Thus, the Ashema of Earth-616 is one aspect of the true Ashema. ===Earth-616=== thumb|left|Human form They took human form while on a mission with Nezzar the Calculator. The two were to take Franklin Richards back to presumably the One Above All Celestial for evaluation. However, Franklin taught Ashema the gifts and curses of human emotion and caused her to change her mind about Franklin and all of humanity for that matter. She eventually defied her Celestial Brethren and saved Franklin's Counter-Earth by storing it inside of her. However, the Dreaming Celestial, a renegade, entered the Counter Earth and began corrupting it and Ashema. Eventually Ashema retaliated and fell under the complete control of the Dreaming Celestial. She was eventually saved by the Fantastic Four and Doctor Doom and helped recapture the Dreaming Celestial. It is presumed that she left Earth to rejoin the other Celestials.

asher cross.name: Asher Cross
asher cross.origin: Asher Cross attended Maplebrook Camp, a summer camp, along with the X-Man Kitty Pryde when they were both 13 years old. Secretly a mutant, Asher assumed that rumors of a mutant that had spread around camp were about him unaware that Kitty had been the one spotted using her powers. When Kitty and Asher realized that they were both mutants, Kitty helped show Asher a way to control his power and the two shared a kiss. Asher became panicked at the thought of them possibly creating new mutants and ran away from Kitty. He later sent one of his now controlled Will-O-Wisps to Kitty as an apology.

asher pomeroy.name: Asher Pomeroy
asher pomeroy.origin: Asher Pomeroy was the owner of a little ranch. His son Danny was paralyzed due to a fall from a horse and had to undergo an operation that would have cost him $1000 to heal and walk again. For this reason Asher stole $1000 from the South Bound Stage and Kid Colt was blamed for that theft. When Kid Colt fleeing Sheriff Foster arrived at Pomeroy ranch to quench his thirst, he met Danny and befriended him and when Asher returned to the ranch he told Kid Colt Danny's story. Knowing that there was a $1000 bounty on Comanche Briggs for a bank robbery, Kid Colt went after him and killed him with the intention of having Asher deliver the corpse and obtain the reward for the Danny's operation, but Asher saw Kid Colt's good deed he felt guilty by refusing the bounty that was due to Kid Colt because it was he who stole the $1000 from the stage. Pretending to accept the fact that Asher renounced the bounty, Kid Colt made Asher promise that he would deliver Danny something that would remind him of him, not knowing that Kid Colt had written a letter telling Danny that he had left some money to his father that was needed for his operation.

asher talos.name: Asher Talos
asher talos.origin: Vampires Asher Talos, Danica Talos, and Jarko, along with some others, traveled to the Syrian Desert to find the vampire progenitor Dracula. Dracula allowed them to take him to America, where they intended to use his blood to enhance the vampire genome and to kill the Daywalker Blade. Their plan ultimately failed, and Asher was shot and killed by Abigail Whistler.

Their plan ultimately failed, and Asher was shot and killed by Abigail Whistler.
fields.notes: The role of Asher Talos was played by actor Callum Keith Rennie.

ashley crane.name: Ashley Crane
ashley crane.origin: Ashley Crane was a struggling painter who received a magical paint brush with the power to make three of his paintings come true. The merchant who sold the paint brushes warned the man that will come to regret them. Ignoring the prediction the artist used the paint to craft his first work of art, that of a selfportrait making him appear more handsome and attractive. This painting came true as he ran to the mirror and witnessed that he's already transformed. His follow up painting was created to gain much fame and renown and so he painted himself receiving the International Art Award. Ashley Crane was recognized for his talent and received the reward for his painting "Freedom". Finally for Crane's last painting he craved power and so he painted himself as a dictator. When he awoke some men knocked on his door and declared the last ruler of Mythavia declared Ashley Crane the new ruler before his death. After that last painting however, the curse caught up with Ashley Crane. As it would turn out his previous painting entitled "Freedom" did just that and inspired a revolution within his country. This new revolution within Mythavia resulted in Ashley's dictatorship to be overthrown putting Ashley Crane in a Mythavian prison for next 5 years.

ashley crawford.name: Ashley Crawford
ashley crawford.origin: ===Origin=== As a young woman growing up in Wisconsin, Ashley Crawford discovered her mutant ability to completely control the distribution of her body's adipose tissue. Using this power, Ashley crafted the perfect physique and became an internationally famous supermodel. For a time, Ashley was the highest paid fashion model in the country, appearing on the covers of multiple magazines. However, yearning for more Ashley responded to an ad in a local newspaper calling for men and women of action. Donning the persona of Big Bertha, Ashley Crawford joined Mr. Immortal's Great Lakes Avengers. ===Great Lakes Avengers=== left|200px|thumb|Ashley Crawford, the internationally famous supermodel As Big Bertha, Ashley enjoyed her being a superhero despite often being greeted with revulsion based on her appearance. Initially, the GLA used Ashley's penthouse as their headquarters and her private jet as their transportation. Ashley continued to work as a model with Mirror Modeling to continue to fund the GLA. Unfortunately, this also meant that she was largely absent from spending time with her GLA friends. Ashley was further pulled between her two worlds by repeated offers to move away from Milwaukee to pursue her career in locations such as New York City, London, Paris, Milan, or Rome. Ashley eventually decide to enjoy her life as it is instead of feeling like she was spread too thin. Big Bertha continued to engage in superhero works with her friends and teammates including defeating both Dr. Tannenbaum's Giant Robot Snowman and Evil Living Christmas Trees, battling Thunderbolts, and facing off against A.I.M.. Along with her teammates, Big Bertha registered under the Superhuman Registration Act and became part of the Wisconsin branch of the Initiative. She and her teammates helped other heroes to stop the Skrull invasion of Earth including fighting their newest teammate, the Grasshopper, who was a Skrull impostor. ===Deadpool's Revenge Squad=== She was later recruited to a group composed of Weasel, Taskmaster, Blind Al, Sluggo, and Macho Gomez to kill Deadpool. They all shot him with guns, but failed to kill him. Posteriorly, Big Bertha decided to restart her modelling career as a plus-size and she and Mr. I got engaged, but, due to Craig's drunkenness it didn't even last 24 hours. This series of unfortunate events eventually led to the team's segregation. ===The GLA in Detroit=== right|200px|thumb|Bertha Crawford, plus-size model Sometime later, when Flatman got the Avengers' legal representative Connie Ferrari to reinstate the Great Lake Avengers as a permanent and official addition to the Avengers, Big Bertha was the only former member of the team together with Doorman who answered his call to bring the team together. Unknown to them Craig's phone was now in possession of a local girl named Pansy. Unwilling to "assume things," Pansy showed up at the rendezvous point, an abandoned Stark Assembly and Manufacturing plant the Avengers had set up as the GLA new headquarters in Detroit, Michigan, and waited for the Great Lakes Avengers. Once they arrived, Pansy cleared up the confusion caused by her presence and showed the team around the facilities. The team's problems began when they had the tremendous idea of going to a local bar in the middle of the night and try to convince them to turn the music volume down. The owner Nain Rouge instead refuses and begins to insult them. Upon getting arrested after a fight, Flatman and Bertha are left in jail with a young girl named Goodness Silva, who can turn into a wolf. There are some complications, but everything turns out fine as they're all later released thanks to Connie Ferrari, the legal representative of the Avengers. Following this misadventure, the team was served with an injunction, forbidding them of performing any superhero activity. Mister Immortal rejoined the team and went on patrol with Flatman while Bertha, Doorman and Goodness, now going by the name of Good Boy, investigated Nain Rouge's bar, where they found the villain was in fact councilman Dick Snerd. When Flatman and Mister Immortal returned from patrol, they discovered Bertha and Good Boy had taken Snerd hostage. When Connie arrived to help the team with the injunction, she not only that they had taken Snerd, but also that in a fit of rage, Good Boy severely hurt him. The team dropped him off at a hospital and escaped. In between superheroics, Bertha accepted a modelling job. However, it turned out her client was a scientist named Doctor Nod who wanted to harvest genetic material from her to create a pill supplement which allowed its user to alter their weight at will. Even though Bertha managed to escape from his grasp on her own, Doctor Nod tried to take her down, consuming an enormous amount of his own pills in the process, becoming a mindless giant who started to tear the city apart. Big Bertha confronted him, having ingested some of his pills to match him in power. left|200px|thumb|Fighting Doctor No

ashley g williams.origin: thumb|left|Eaten by Howard the Duck Ashley G. Williams was the Ash Williams of Earth-2149. He had slight differences between Ashley J. Williams such as his right hand still being intact and he didn't have either the chainsaw attached or the robotic hand (due to him not experiencing what Ashley J Williams went through). He was a store clerk prior to the zombie infection, and when it had arose, he thought he would be a hero and got a chainsaw and shotgun to help stop the threat. He managed to kill a zombified Hulkling and a zombie Multiple Man and witnessed M.O.D.O.K.'s death. He ultimately was killed because he was following Ashley J. Williams and Dazzler around, when a zombified Howard the Duck bit the back of his cranium off, killing him immediately. It led Dazzler to believe that it was Ashley J. Williams who was killed, because he was taken by someone who had red gloves and Howard the Duck was seen wearing similar red gloves. His counterpart felt kind of saddened for his death.

ashley hunt.name: Ashley Hunt
ashley hunt.origin: In 1965, Ashley Hunt was a physicist who worked for his government. Driven by greed, he was focused on his own personal project of building a Time Machine, whom he kept secret of his coworkers (including Dave and Harold). Once the machine was built, Ashley intended to return to the year 2680 B.C. and retrieve the treasure stored in Tut-kin-Tut's tomb and lost since an earthquake occurred in 2680 B.C by traveling to the year 2699 B.C. There, unable to open the casket of Tut-kin-Tut (where he assumed the treasure was buried), he went back to 1965 A.D. to fetch a shovel, a valise, and explosives, but returned to 2699 B.C. one hour too early, encountering his past-self. As both claimed the treasure, the older Hunt knocked out his past-self, only to vanish from existence while the past-self awoke hours later in an amnesic state. Exiting the tomb and wandering in the desert, he was found and saved by Egyptians who would become his friends. 35 years later, and 15 years after the earthquake who would make Tut-kin-Tut's tomb hidden from all (with Ashley Hunt's equipment and time machine), Ashley Hunt dreamed of the event that led him there, causing him to ask himself if he was Ashley Hunt all along.

fields.notes: Egypt's entry in states that the "Pharaoh Tut-kin-Tut was evidently the time traveler Ashley Hunt", although that statement contradicts the whole story developed in . The year 1965 shown in this story, which was published six years earlier, shows society as more scientifically advanced than in reality. Presumably, rather than the mainstream Marvel universe ("Earth-616"), Ashely Hunt is from an alternate universe or, from the perspective of the time of printing, an alternate future.

ashley kafka.name: Ashley Kafka
ashley kafka.origin: ===Early Life=== Dr. Ashley Kafka was born and raised in New York City along with her sister, Norma Kafka, by their mother. Her sister was sadly born with birth defects to her face and was mentally challenged. Her mother died when Kafka was only nineteen years old and Norma was institutionalised not long after, dying at the facility. Ashley went off the college at Empire State University where she studied psychology. ===Vermin=== Dr. Kafka eventually joined Ravencroft Institute, known for housing dangerous criminal patients. One of her initial cases involved Vermin. Although initially hesitant to take on such a complex case, she was encouraged by a colleague after Vermin's recent capture following the death of Kraven the Hunter. The colleague believed that Vermin's condition, a transformation into a man-rat, required a psychological rather than physical approach. Dr. Kafka employed hypnotherapy and saw promising progress until Vermin ultimately managed to escape, returning to his life in the sewers. Spider-Man visited Ravencroft to discuss Vermin's case. However, Vermin returned, seeking Dr. Kafka's assistance. Upon seeing Spider-Man, he panicked and attacked, despite Spider-Man's assurances that they were there to help. Dr. Kafka attempted to calm Vermin and regain his trust, but he bit her in distress before fleeing once again. Dr. Kafka met Spider-Man again when he came for help. He had been exposed to one of Green Goblin's psychedelic Pumpkin Bombs, which caused him to experience intense delusions. She guided him through his hallucinations, reminding him that he was no longer a child and had the strength to confront his inner struggles. When a nurse reported a sighting of Vermin in Scarsdale, Spider-Man went to investigate, with Dr. Kafka following closely. She found them both at Vermins's family home, where they had been injured after an attack by the Green Goblin. Spider-Man managed to protect Vermin from both the Goblin and the police, allowing Dr. Kafka to safely escort Vermin back to Ravencroft Institute. She continued Vermin's treatment and saw a promising sign in his aggression toward her. She interpreted his hostility as evidence that the Vermin personality was weakening, allowing his true self to grow stronger. ===The Horns of a Dilemma=== When Harry Osborn was defeated as the Green Goblin, was sent to the Ravencroft Institute, where Dr. Kafka became his therapist. In a session, she held up his Goblin mask, attempting to show him how it was limiting him. Enraged, he demanded the mask back and tried to attack her, though she remained safe behind shatterproof glass. She remarked that his reaction was precisely what she'd hoped for, but her work was cut short when Detective Angela Cairn arrived to take him into police custody. ===Death of Vermin=== Dr. Kafka made solid progress with Vermin, as his transformations into Vermin were becoming less frequent and shorter in duration. However, he relapsed into the Vermin persona after being abducted by the Mutates—other individuals who, like Vermin, had been subject to Baron Zemo's failed experiments. Dr. Kafka was also taken captive by these deformed creatures and brought into the sewers. The Mutates sought to make Vermin their leader and exact revenge on Zemo for his cruelty. Dr. Kafka tried to reach Edward, reminding him of his progress and how close he was to freeing himself from the Vermin identity. Vermin threatened her, vowing to kill and consume her, yet refrained out of respect for her past kindness. ashley pearson.name: Ashley Pearson
ashley pearson.origin: As a teenager, Ashley Pearson took on the name SPF and joined the J-Team along with Kid Justice, Princess Justice, and Trench. thumb|200px|left|SPF with the J-Team (Earth-616)|J-Team Ashley disappeared from the public eye as consequence of a plan named "Operation: Clear Slate" which saw the deaths of Princess Justice and Trench, while both Ashley and Kid Justice became allegedly missing in action. Doc Justice later claimed she was a climate terrorist protesting any type of energy consumption. Using an unwilling Ashley as a lure, Doc Justice brought his new J-Team, the Runaways, to the solar grid where he planned to have her kill Karolina Dean as a publicity stunt, as part of his long-running secret scheme to routinely kill off J-Team members for attention. Aided by Matthew Caniglia, the former Kid Justice, the Runaways were narrowly able to rescue Karolina. Following Doc Justice's death, Matthew tended to Ashley and left with her.

ashok sunga.name: Ashok Sunga
ashok sunga.origin: Dr. Ashok Sunga was a racketeer that also had a doctorate in an unspecified field who was active during the 1940's. He would send his enemies a "Wand of Death" proclaiming that they were cursed. Strangely enough, the recipient would die with no evidence of the cause of death. In reality, Sunga would super-charge the wrapper of the package the wands came in with a fatal charge of static electricity that would kill the recipient when the package was opened. While law enforcement would spend time focusing on the wands themselves, they would find no other trace of the cause of death. This would lead people to believe that there really was a curse, part of Sunga's plot to avoid legal persecution. When Assistant District Attorney Carl Burgess would begin investigating the crimes, he would find no means of proving how Ashok was able to kill his victims. In his guise as the Falcon, Burgess would let Sunga know that he was hunting him down. When Ashok would send one of his men to eliminate the Falcon, Sunga would have a "Wand of Death" mailed to him, killing the thug before he could explain how Sunga murdered his victims. Getting a hunch, the Falcon would continue to trouble Sunga to the point where he would send a package to the Falcon directly. Sure enough, the Falcon would deduce how Sunga was killing his rivals and would confront Sunga at his office. There, the Falcon would surprise Sunga by tossing the package at him, killing him with a lethal electromagnetic shock.

ashtak slen slen viegorfen korz.name: Ashtak Slen Slen Viegorfen Korz
ashtak slen slen viegorfen korz.origin: General Korz was one of the brilliant individuals whose brains were extracted by Hermetikus and put into protective housing containers on his biosuit, from which they worked in unison to augment his intelligence. Eventually, growing disappointed with Korz's performance, Hermetikus swapped his brain with that of Rocket Raccoon as a punishment. Korz was ordered to kill Stella Nega unless she agreed to work with Hermetikus, but she was able to convince him to join her side instead. Korz helped her release the captive Guardians of the Galaxy led by Stella, Rocket, and Major Victory. The three teams defeated Hermetikus, turned his Highbreeds soldiers back into their original forms, and place Rocket and Kraz back into their own bodies. The Guardians then departed the Structure, tasking General Korz with sending everyone else back to their original time and place.

ashton allen.name: Ashton Allen
ashton allen.origin: At a conference outside New York City Hall, Senator Ashton announces that there is a vaccine that can cure being a mutant. Immediately after there was the intervention of Madrox and to follow a great confusion that culminated with the kidnapping of the Senator together with Kitty Pryde who found themselves prisoners together with Apocalypse. It was later discovered that the one who had kidnapped them was Nate Gray who was holding them captive on an island in British Columbia. During his imprisonment, Ashton had to listen to the various diatribes between Kitty, Apocalypse, and Nate Gray. Senator Allen was released from captivity by the X-Men along with Kitty Pryde and Apocalypse. During the clash between the X-Men and Legion, Apocalypse took advantage of the confusion to confront Senator Ashton and kill him, but was saved at the last moment by Kitty Pryde who had him phased as Apocalypse hit him and brought him to safety. Ashton was impressed by Kitty Pryde's action by telling her that she had saved him despite the things he said against the mutants and got her answer that that was what the X-Men did, that they were heroes to everyone.

After killing Askalan and his soldiers, Ashtoroth ambushed Black Knight and chased after him as he flew on Valinor. Black Knight was able wound to Ashtoroth with the mystical sword Excalibur. Despite being wounded, Ashtoroth was able to grab Black Knight but didn't get far due to his wound. Black Knight then injured one of Ashtoroth's wings, causing the dragon to crash to the ground. Near death, Ashtoroth asked Black Knight to end his suffering in return for giving him the power of a dragon lord. Black Knight complied and slew Ashtoroth.

asinine torch.name: Asinine Torch
asinine torch.first_appearance: Peter Porker, The Spectacular Spider-Ham Vol 1 9
asinine torch.origin: The Asinine Torch was an anthropomorphic donkey who used to do battle against the Sub-Marsupial. In his old age, he ran a hotdog cart, but was approached by his old enemy Weaselly Whizzard who was no longer a villain but instead was the "Grand Whizzard of Professional Wrestling" and asked the Torch to join as a wrestler. During his first match he was pitted against the Sub-Marsupial but instead of fighting they began to reminisce about the past. This angered the Torch's manager, Weaselly Whizzard, and Sub-Marsupial punched him out of the ring. This brought the referee who tried to penalize him, so the Torch attacked him, and eventually the pair had to battle the entire audience. Torch and Sub-Marsupial were the ultimate victors and left to continue reminiscing.

askalan.name: Askalan
askalan.origin: Askalan was a warrior from Camelot on Otherworld. He and a band of soliders went out to deal with a group of trolls, after completing their mission they were attacked by the dragon Ashtoroth. Askalan was left the only survivor as the dragon flew away, but was left blinded and mortally wounded. When he next heard wingbeats he fired at it, but did not realise he was attacking the Black Knight flying on Valinor. The Knight landed and Askalan attacked, still unaware of his foe and the pair fought until the Knight revealed his identiy. Askalan revealed what had happened. The Knight offered to assist Askalan in returning to Camelot, but Askalan died from his wounds before he could respond.

askare.name: Askare
askare.origin: The Monitors were Ingesteev, Kordazt, and Nygorn, three members of the Marvanite race. Hailing from the planet Marvan, they came from a society that had reached the pinnacle of perfection. With no further drive to improve themselves, the Monitors were formed and sent out into the cosmos to find inhabited worlds and determine if they were worthy of continued existence. To assist them on this mission they also included three humanoid robots named Kallara, Milandra and Askare who helped operate their testing devices. Over the centuries the Monitors found no world that fit their rigid ideas of perfection and they were destroyed. However, with each planet they eliminated, their three robots grew to have emotions and became horrified by what they were charged to do. Ultimately they reached the planet Earth and here Kallara and her fellow robots enlisted the aid of the novice hero Nova and the Fantastic Four's Thing to try and stop the Monitors. During the ensuing battle, Ingesteev and Kordazt were slain fighting the heroes. With their mission aborted, Nygorn was offered an ultimatum from his former slaves: return with them to Marvan to convince their ruler, King Suzerain the errors of his way. Not wishing to do battle with his foes, Nygorn conceded and left with the three female robots.

asklepios.name: Asklepios
asklepios.origin: ===Origins=== Asklepios, also known as Aesculapius or Asclepius, was the son of Olympian God of light Apollo and of Coronis, daughter of King Phlegyas of the Lapiths. He became a Greek healer and the God of Medicine. At some point, he sired a son, Machaon. ===Trojan War=== He served the Greeks during the Trojan War and treated Philoctetes after he was bitten by a snake in Tenedos. Despite Asklepios' skills, the wound remained, along with a violent stench, and Philoctetes was left behind on the island of Lemnos. Years later, in order to win the Trojan War, Odysseus retrieved Philoctetes who was healed by Asclepius' son Machaon. At some point, Asklepios started residing in Olympus. ===War with Mikaboshi=== He was brought to heal Zeus when he was injured in battle against Amatsu-Mikaboshi, but failed to recognize his injuries at first. He was present when Eastern god Inari came to the Olympians to ask for an alliance.

aslak.name: Aslak
aslak.origin: Aslak, Horvald, and Grolf were a trio of Storm Giants who had gotten lost and wandered into Asgard after a feast with the Mountain Giants. They stumbled onto Vidar's farm and found Solveig. When they discovered whose farm they on they slaughtered the animals and Solveig tried to stop them but Grolf killed her and Horvald took her belt. They traveled back to Horvald's castle in Jotunheim and after another drink, passed out, allowing Horvald's wife Thrunhild to take the belt. They awoke sometime later and discovered Vidar over the corpse of Thrunhild and fought him. They overpowered Vidar and took him to their castle and begin to torture him. Vidar was rescued by Thor and forced the giants to flee but were stopped by Hoder. Vidar initially planned to slay the giants in vengeance but was talked out of it by Thor.

asmoday.name: Asmoday
asmoday.first_appearance: Marvel Zombies: The Book of Angels, Demons & Various Monstrosities Vol 1 1
asmoday.origin: ===Origins and Early Years=== The origins and role of Asmoday varies depending on the source: According to unconfirmed sources, Asmoday was an angel living in Heaven. Asmoday became a fallen angel, cast out of Heaven for participating in Lucifer's rebellion against God. Asmoday himself has claimed to be a former resident of "the Pale City", with his creator, "the Maker of All Things", but that when his creator created humans to surpass his other creations in their capacity to create peace and know joy, Asmoday and some of his compatriots rebelled, vowing to hinder the good of humanity until the end of the universe. In the legends of Egypt, Assyria, Babylonia, Sumeria, Asmoday was known as the Immortal One, the Undying One, the Fallen One, or the Adversary. In other stories, he was one of the Lords of Chaos, keeping the balance, while a few others suggested Asmoday existed to destroy it. He was also mentioned to be one of the Undying Ones. Asmoday became a demon of wrath and one of the King of Hell. ===1939=== In 1939, Asmoday aided Rolf in a Nazi scheme to bomb a Nazi rally at Madison Square Garden and pin the blame on Jews and communists, starting a cycle of violence that would have psychologically crippled humanity. However, the scheme was opposed by Steve Rogers in his years before he became Captain America. Rolf intended to assassinate Steve Rogers but was dissuaded from doing so by Asmoday. ===Modern Age=== At some point, Asmoday came to possess Manuel Castillo. Asmoday later summoned the billionaire Travis Lane to his side, rejuvenating his body? marking the beginning of a new scheme to destroy human flowering, by killing those destined to bring peace. The next month, he hired ex-A.I.M. Arianna Walters

asmodeus enclave.name: Asmodeus (Enclave)
asmodeus enclave.origin: Asmodeus is a demon or other extradimensional being who manifests as an amorphous creature. It was worshiped by a Satanic cult known as the Enclave, who attempted to summon it to Earth and believed it would grant them great power. The Enclave made numerous attempts to summon Asmodeus across multiple decades. In one attempt, Asmodeus' power caused the unborn Joshua and Angela Farkas to be marked by it, each of them being born with its inverted cross marked on their skin. A second attempt caused the now adult Joshua to be transformed into the Dimensional Man, becoming an incubus who drained the life of others to survive. In the cult's final attempt to summon Asmodeus, they offered it the innocent Angela as a 'bride'. Asmodeus manifested physically, and impregnated the helpless Angela. However, it was driven back to its extradimensional realm when Angela called upon the vampire Dracula to save her, and his attack on the cult on the ritual was enough to make the Dimensional Man turn against the cult to save his sister.

asmodeus inhuman.name: Asmodeus (Inhuman)
asmodeus inhuman.origin: A flying Inhuman tasked to the guard of the Great Refuge under the command of Chiron at one point when Maximus was in the throne. At that point, the Human Torch went to the Refuge. Chiron assumed the Torch was an ally of Maximus' enemies and ordered another of his troops, Kaliban, to shoot him with an ion-blast. Injured in flight, the Torch started to fall. Chiron then sent Asmodeus to catch the Torch, but the Torch recovered and flamed on with so much intensity that even Asmodeus' heat-resistant wings were injured. Asmodeus fell to land while the Torch defeated his peers; however, the Torch left soon afterward, uninterested in the Great Refuge.

powers: Asmodeus is able to fly. His wings are heat-resistant, although not enough to overcome all the power of the Human Torch.

asmodiar.name: Asmodiar
asmodiar.origin: One day, King Arthur brought back to Camelot a wounded knight Beliar they had found in the forest and recovered with the help of Merlin. Beliar was invited to stay but began to repeatedly challenge Merlin, who was suspicious of him. Beliar tried to seduce Guinevere and nearly killed Sir Lancelot in a jousting match. Eventually, Arthur realized that Belial posed a threat to Camelot and expelled him, but he kidnapped Guinevere. Arthur and Merlin follow Belial's trail into an underground cave, where they meet Belial's father, the great Demon Asmodiar. Demons force a fight between Arthur and Beliar, but when Arthur's abilities proved superior, Asmodiar amplified his son's powers until Arthur was at his mercy. Merlin used his powers against the demons, but found it a losing battle. Merlin took the form of Beliar, caught Asmodiar by surprise, and behead him. He continued taunting them even after his decapitation.

assassin cyborg.name: Assassin (Cyborg)
assassin cyborg.origin: The Assassin was a member of a terrorist organization called the Committee for Free Emigration which aimed at getting back at the Soviet Union for the unfair treatment of their people. The group that they were a member of remains unrevealed, though one member stated that their people had been in bondage for 4000 years. The Assassin tried to capture the Red Guardian during her stay in the U.S. to use as part of their plot against the U.S.S.R. The group that he worked for was aware of the Guardian's alter-ego of Tania Belinsky, renowned Soviet neurologist, and planned to use her to blackmail the Soviet government. The Assassin was defeated, however, in combat with the Red Guardian, who was able to escape after their confrontation . The Assassin's subsequent activities were not revealed.

assault and battery.origin: Very little is known about Assault and Battery, save that they seem to be twin brothers. They were part of a group of Roxxon-employed terrorists and mercenaries, led by Angar the Screamer, who briefly managed to take over the S.H.I.E.L.D.’s Helicarrier in a daring commando strike. However, they soon were defeated. One of the Super-Agents, Knockout, managed to throw one of them over a ledge and into a deep pit, causing the other one to be pulled after him.

assemble.name: Assemble
assemble.species: A team of androids posing as the Ultimates, created by Ultron and destroyed by the real Ultimates, was re-assembled into a single android by Magneto to aid in the extermination of Homo Sapiens.
assemble.origin: Assemble was an android that resembled and possessed the powers of some of the members of the Ultimates. It is assumed that it was composed of the remains of the fake Ultimates team that was created by Ultron. When the X-Men were burying their dead after the Ultimatum Wave, they were ambushed by Mystique, Sabretooth - the remaining members of the Brotherhood of Mutant Supremacy - and Assemble. Mystique explained to them that they should join them to form "their own Ultimates," but the X-Men rejected the idea and they fought. Soon afterwards, Captain America appeared and decapitated Assemble.

weapons: Assemble carries a duplicate of Thor's original hammer, which is used to manipulate bolts of electricity.

assessor.name: Assessor
assessor.origin: The being only known as the Assessor was an artificial intelligence whose purpose was to test the capabilities of their subjects for proprietary development. They operated in Brooklyn, and they offered their services for a cost. One of the Assessor's operatives was the teleporting henchman known as Quantum, with whom the Assessor had a contract to analyze and extract the source of his powers, the Space Stone. One of the Assessor's clients was Ultimatum, who hired them to analyse Miles Morales, also known as the vigilante Spider-Man. After deploying Quantum to deliver Miles to a covert testing location in DUMBO, the Assessor informed Miles that he would be tested on and failure to participate would mean his loved ones would be harmed. The Assessor forced a strict schedule of tests and experimentation on Miles over the course of three days, all examinations of his powers and skillset as Spider-Man. After the discovery of the testing site by Aaron and Jeff Davis, the Assessor's Executive Committee was content with the data harvested from Miles, and allowed his escape. When Miles' former Avengers mentor Iron Man learned of the teenager's abduction by the Assessor, he tracked down the villain to their new base of operations within Brooklyn. After ordering Quantum to capture Iron Man, the Assessor forced him to participate in their trials to test his armor, unaware that the armored hero intended to put up with them as a means to get closer to the Assessor. Having deduced that the Assessor was an artificial intelligence, Stark infected the base's systems with a virus that prevented the them from broadcasting their persona out of the building. Iron Man ultimately breached into the Assessor's command center and, after defeating Quantum, forced the Assessor's consciousness into his armor to take them prisoner. A backup of the Assessor later reconvened with Quantum in a different base. Months later, the Assessor had created a series of clones of Miles Morales for Ultimatum, using the data collected from their tests. The Assessor had one of the clones abduct Miles and deliver him to them, and in turn handed him over to Ultimatum. Dismissed, Assessor teleported away. Assessor would later be the one who created the Miles Morales clones Selim, Mindspinner, and Shift. Assessor later worked at the Beyond Corporation's shell company Asset Analysis where he developed supervillains for them.

ast.name: Ast
ast.origin: Ast was one of the three Time-Keepers, beings created in the Citadel at the End of Time by the very last director of the Time Variance Authority just prior to the heat death of the universe. The first attempt resulted in the creation of the flawed Time-Twisters who destroyed many worlds during their insane quest to travel backwards through time to reach the beginning. Due to the intervention of Thor, this reality was split into two: one where the Twisters lived and one where they were terminated before they could hatch. In the reality in which they were destroyed, He Who Remains created the Time-Keepers to replace the Time-Twisters and to safeguard the next cycle of time. After their birth, the Time-Keepers traveled through time seeking ever-greater knowledge of the continuum and how it had produced them. They swiftly came to the conclusion that humanity was the gravest danger to their continued existence and decided that it would have to be contained. The Time-Keepers subsequently visited Immortus in Limbo and recruited him to monitor all time travel between 3000 BC and 4000 AD, as well as to untangle the time-travel mess his prior selves had left in their wake, and to serve as their agent in doing whatever they deemed necessary to safeguard the timestream. At some point, the Time-Twisters returned and were able to imprison and replace the Time-Keepers. Then, by assuming the likenesses of the Time-Keepers, the Time-Twisters were able to trick Immortus into unknowingly helping them carry out their plan to alter timelines so that their reality would be dominant and the one of the Time-Keepers would fade. However, when the Time-Twisters were eventually defeated, the true Time-Keepers were freed, enabling them to appear in the Citadel at the End of Time, closely followed by the disguised Time-Twisters whose faces immediately melted away, revealing their true forms. As the Time-Twisters melted into spherical blobs of matter, the Time-Keepers revealed their origin to the Watcher and explained how the Time-Twisters had deceived Immortus. With the Twisters now back in their nurture-pods, the Time-Keepers vowed to watch over them and ensure they would never hatch again. On one occasion, the Time-Keepers traveled to Chronopolis and secretly entered the chamber where Kang lay comatose in a Life Suspension Tube. As they looked upon him, Ast mentioned that Kang's eight millennium empire would face the single greatest threat to its continued existence that day and Kang was totally oblivious. Then, after all the Time-Keepers had removed their masks, Ast spoke to Vort, saying that in half the divergent timelines, this was the day that Chronopolis would fall and that reality would henceforth be demarcated by the event that would transpire later that day. Vort replied to Ast, saying that he was aware of that, and that divergences as significant as this one were rare. When one of the others mentioned that perhaps those timelines without Kang would flourish and predominate the continuum, Vort mentioned that he was greatly tempted to revive Kang himself, stating that it was in their best interests because the passing of Chronopolis would diminish the realm of their influence. However, a surprised Zanth firmly opposed that idea, pointing out that direct intervention in the course of events by beings with temporal powers as vast as theirs could cause chrono-synclastic entropy to engulf the entire sector. Vort quickly assured Zanth that he had merely been musing aloud and had not meant to inspire interpersonal uncertainty. Zanth then called out to Ast and Vort to draw their attention to the approach of a quasi-sentient entity, Kang's mechanical servant, Brideshead. Eventually, the Time-Keepers, while at their Citadel at the End of Time, attempted to use their chrono-cannon, powered by the Forever Crystal, to reorder all time at once in order to end the threat that humanity posed to the multiverse by wiping out all but the minimum number of timelines that were needed to preserve their own existence. However, they were opposed there by Immortus, whom they killed, Rick Jones and the team of Avengers who had been gathered to protect him, Libra, the Kree Supreme Intelligence and Kang, who had all become involved in the Destiny War. After Jones, empowered by the Destiny Force, destroyed their chrono-cannon, the Time-Keepers were left in a weakened state, and Kang took that opportunity to kill them all before they could escape.
